title: Capacity
description: Physical room capacity specifying maximum occupancy limits broken down by guest age.

child_age_ranges.description: Child age brackets and optional per-bracket capacity limits. A guest whose age falls within a bracket is counted as a child; otherwise as an adult.

min.description: Lowest age in this bracket, inclusive, in completed years at check-in.

max.description: Highest age in this bracket, inclusive, in completed years at check-in.

limit.description: Maximum number of children permitted within this age bracket (e.g., crib or extra bed limit). When absent, bounded only by overall capacity.children.

total.description: Maximum number of total occupants (adult or child). If adults and/or children are present, this MUST be greater than or equal to max(adults, children).
